_about: Generated-asset slots for scripts/video/render_sim_video.py. Park names/cities from data/reference/mlb_teams_2026.json (MLB Stats API). Text, numbers and logos are never generated: the renderer typesets them.
fallback: Any park with no plate or clip is drawn by code as a to-scale fence/diamond outline from its MLB Stats API fieldInfo, in the team ink on cream.
